Message.Name: Mutual Funds Trades Message
Message.Description: Any transaction made in mutual funds is reported.

Field.Name: Instrument Number
Field.Description: Sole code throughout the life on the instrument

Field.Name: Date of the Trade
Field.Description: Date when the trade was made

Message.Name: Opening of continuous auctions Message
Message.Description: The message is sent when one of the ongoing, volatility or SIC bidding sessions is generated.

Field.Name: Instrument Number
Field.Description: Sole code throughout the life on the instrument

Field.Name: Auction session startup time
Field.Description: Time when the auction session opens

Field.Name: Auction session end time
Field.Description: Time when the auction session ends

Message.Name: Existence of bids at Mid-Price Message
Message.Description: This message is generated when an instrument enters a bid in the hidden electronic book At Mean Price.

Field.Name: Instrument Number
Field.Description: Sole code throughout the life on the instrument

Field.Name: Bids Existing
Field.Description: If the value is "1", it will be construed as true (there are bids), in any other case it will be false (there are no bids).

Message.Name: Catalogue of Debt and Metals instruments Message
Message.Description: Catalogue sent for instruments pertaining to the Local Fixed rate, Global Fixed rate and metals markets.

Field.Name: Number of the instrument
Field.Description: Sole code throughout the life of the instrument

Field.Name: Reference
Field.Description: N – Prior, “ ” – W/O Price, V – Adjusted Nominal Value

Field.Name: Coupon/Period
Field.Description: Coupon number in effect or period number

Field.Name: Market
Field.Description: D – Local debt, F- Global debt, E – Money

Field.Name: Trades Rate/Price
Field.Description: T - Rate P - Price " "- By default

Message.Name: Catalog sent for instruments belonging to mutual funds Message
Message.Description: Catalogue sent for instrument pertaining to the investment companies.

Field.Name: Number of the instrument
Field.Description: Sole code throughout the life of the instrument

Field.Name: Sector
Field.Description: See Industry Classification on the Connections and Appendix document

Field.Name: Sub-sector
Field.Description: See Industry Classification on the Connections and Appendix document

Field.Name: Industry
Field.Description: See Industry Classification on the Connections and Appendix document

Field.Name: Sub-industry
Field.Description: See Industry Classification on the Connections and Appendix document

Field.Name: Trading company
Field.Description: Code of the trading company of the investment fund

Field.Name: Reference
Field.Description: N – Prior, J – Adjusted, “ ” – W/O Price

Message.Name: Weighted Average Price Message
Message.Description: This message will have the weighted average price (WAP) per instrument and is sent for each transaction generated within the calculation period of the WAP (last 20 minutes of the trading session); when there are no more trades in this period, the message is sent with the Weighted Average Price in zeros.

Field.Name: Instrument Number
Field.Description: Sole code throughout the life on the instrument

Message.Name: System events Message
Message.Description: The system events message is used to inform that an event has taken place, which needs to be disclosed to the public for its attention.

Field.Name: Instrument Number
Field.Description: Sole code throughout the life of the instrument. If zero, it applies for the market or group, depending on the Origin

Field.Name: Code of event
Field.Description: See Catalogue of Codes of System Event on the Connections and Appendix document

Field.Name: Market
Field.Description: L-Local G-Global (Used only in case of administrative recess notices)

Field.Name: Send Time
Field.Description: Send time of administrative recess. Used only in case of administrative recess notices.

Field.Name: End Time
Field.Description: End time of administrative recess. Used only in case of administrative recess notices and in the case of an automatic resource.

Field.Name: Group
Field.Description: Group identifier. If blank, it applies at system level.

Message.Name: Reference Price Message
Message.Description: This message is sent to define the reference price of an instrument.

Field.Name: Instrument Number
Field.Description: Sole code throughout the life on the instrument

Field.Name: Price Type
Field.Description: Type of Price sent. See Catalogue of types of price on the Connections and Appendix document

Message.Name: Changes in status Message
Message.Description: This message is sent when there has been a change in the status of the instruments.

Field.Name: Instrument Number
Field.Description: Sole code throughout the life on the instrument

Field.Name: Status
Field.Description: New status of the instrument. See Catalogue of status changes. on the Connections and Appendix document

Field.Name: Reason
Field.Description: Reason for the change of status. See Catalogue of reasons. on the Connections and Appendix document

Message.Name: Catalog for instruments belonging to the capital warrants market Message
Message.Description: Catalogue for instruments pertaining to the Equities Warrants market.

Field.Description: Sole code throughout the life of the instrument (Document label: Type of Message)

Field.Name: Type of value
Field.Description: Code of the Type of Value

Field.Name: Reference
Field.Description: N – Prior, J – Adjusted, “ ” – W/O Price

Message.Name: Catalog sent for instruments belonging to capital TRACS Message
Message.Description: Catalogue sent for instruments pertaining to the equities TRACS.

Field.Name: Number of the Trac
Field.Description: Sole code throughout the life of the instrument

Field.Name: Name of the Trac
Field.Description: Identifies the name of the Trac

Field.Name: Underlying issuing company
Field.Description: Code of the issuing company of the underlying value

Field.Name: Underlying series
Field.Description: Code of the series of the underlying value

Field.Name: Securities
Field.Description: Number of Securities of the underlying value

Field.Name: Excluded Securities
Field.Description: Number of securities excluded from the underlying value

Field.Name: Excluded Value
Field.Description: Estimated value of excluded assets by unit

Field.Name: Number of Certificates

Message.Name: Consolidated INAV Message
Message.Description: Disclosure of the TRACS during the trading hours of the ongoing market.

Field.Description: Sole code assigned to the TRACs

Field.Name: Current Theoretical Price
Field.Description: Last theoretical price of the Trac

Message.Name: Catalog for instruments belonging to the local and global stock market Message
Message.Description: Catalog of instruments from the local and global stock markets.

Field.Name: Value of Type
Field.Description: Code of the Type of Value

Field.Name: Reference
Field.Description: N – Prior, J – Adjusted, “ ” – W/O Price

Field.Name: Marketability
Field.Description: See Marketability Catalog on the Connections and Appendix document

Field.Name: Numerical Marketability
Field.Description: Refer to the BMV Marketability Indices Methodology

Field.Name: Exchange

Message.Name: Probable price of allocation Message
Message.Description: The message is sent during any type of bidding (Opening, Ongoing, Volatility and Intraday) and only in the instruments where there already is a virtual term matching or pre-allotment.

Field.Name: Instrument Number
Field.Description: Sole code throughout the life on the instrument

Message.Name: Relation between BMV/BIVA Instruments Message
Message.Description: Relation between identifiers of instruments between BIVA and BMV.

Field.Name: Number of the BMV Instrument
Field.Description: Sole code throughout the life of the instrument at BMV

Field.Name: BIVA Instrument
Field.Description: Code of the instrument at BIVA

Field.Name: Type of Trading
Field.Description: See Catalogue of Type of BIVA operations on the Connections and Appendix document

Message.Name: Equities Market Trades Message
Message.Description: Informs about any transaction which was accepted at the BMV or BIVA.

Field.Name: Instrument Number
Field.Description: Sole code throughout the life of the instrument

Field.Name: Time of the trade
Field.Description: Time when the transaction took place

Field.Name: Type of Agreement
Field.Description: See Catalogue of Type of Agreement on the Connections and Appendix document

Field.Name: Sets Price
Field.Description: If the Value is 1, it will be construed as true, in any other case it will be false.

Field.Name: Type of Trading
Field.Description: See Catalogue of Type of Trading on the Connections and Appendix document

Field.Name: Purchases
Field.Description: Short code of the Purchasing Exchange (BMV and BIVA)

Field.Name: Sells
Field.Description: Short code of the Selling Exchange (BMV and BIVA)

Field.Name: Settlement
Field.Description: See Catalogue of Types of Settlement on the Connections and Appendix document

Field.Name: Auction Indicator
Field.Description: "P"-Opening Auction "S"-Other Auctions " "- Continuous Market "N"- Not Applicable

Field.Name: Indicator
Field.Description: Denotes if the execution must be reflected for the volume calculations: "N" – No, "Y" – Yes In the case of the BMV this field does not apply and will be sent blank.

Message.Name: Consolidated Trade Cancellation Message
Message.Description: This message in sent when a transaction is cancelled from BMV or BIVA system.

Field.Name: Instrument Number
Field.Description: Sole code throughout the life on the instrument

Message.Name: Price/volume indicator Message
Message.Description: Price/volume indicator for the messages coming from BIVA.

Field.Name: Instrument Number
Field.Description: Sole code throughout the life on the instrument

Message.Name: Consolidated Execution of Orders Message
Message.Description: The message is published when there is a term matching or closing in the electronic system of the BMV or BIVA.

Field.Name: Instrument Number
Field.Description: Sole code throughout the life on the instrument

Field.Name: Date
Field.Description: Date when the order was registered

Field.Name: Consecutive number
Field.Description: Consecutive Number Assigned to the order when it is recorded

Field.Name: Consecutive Number of the trade
Field.Description: Consecutive Number of the trade with which the order was executed.

Field.Name: Execution price
Field.Description: Price with which the trade was made.

Field.Name: Indicator
Field.Description: Denotes if the execution must be reflected for the volume calculations: "N" – No, "Y" – Yes In the case of the BMV this field does not apply and will be sent blank.

Field.Name: Sets price
Field.Description: If the Value is 1, it will be construed as true, in any other case it will be false. In the case of the BMV this field does not apply and will be sent blank.

Field.Name: Participant
Field.Description: Short key of the aggressive Brokerage House (only when the order comes from BIVA)

Message.Name: Registration of Order Message
Message.Description: When the order is accepted by the central system of the BMV or BIVA, this message is sent to the appropriate media.

Field.Name: Instrument Number
Field.Description: Sole code throughout the life on the instrument

Field.Name: Date and Time
Field.Description: Date and time when the order was registered

Field.Name: Consecutive number
Field.Description: Consecutive Number Assigned to the order when it is recorded

Field.Name: Participant
Field.Description: Short code of the participating Brokerage House (applies to BMV and BIVA)

Message.Name: Cancellations of Orders Message
Message.Description: This message deletes the trading floor order.
